description: Closed list of the view types of the web client's anonymous UI health report (POST /v1/telemetry/ui, ADR-063 section 5, 03-api.md section 4.11, 08-monitoring.md section 6.1). A view type names a route pattern of web/src/ui/screens/*/routes.tsx (a task or session tab after the dot), never an ID. `patterns` maps each type to its route patterns (`#<tab>`: the tab of that screen); routes without a type (the start redirect, the not-found page) and every type a hub does not know yet are counted as `fallback`. `buckets_ms`: the longest blocked interval of a report is bucket i when it is at least buckets_ms[i] and below buckets_ms[i+1] (the last bucket is open). `limits`: the hub clamps count, blocked_ms and max_bucket of each view to these values, refuses more than views_per_report views or a body above body_bytes, and stores at most versions_per_day distinct versions per day (further versions are counted as `other`).
